features.name: repo_trend.py: one trend over all target repos, in the weekly review
features.description: T12 of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-17-two-layer-harness-design.md. Per-repo audits (docs/telemetry/repos/<repo>/<date>.json, committed) and verify-gate runs (<runtime>/telemetry/<repo>/verify-runs-YYYYMM.jsonl, per machine) are only useful together over time. scripts/repo_trend.py [--days N] prints a markdown table per repo: first and latest audit in the window (always-loaded tokens, scoped skill tokens, state-file tokens, drifted hooks, agents wired) and verify runs in the window (count, failures, median and max duration). weekly-review.sh adds it as a 'Target repos' section, so the committed weekly report keeps the per-machine verify numbers.
acceptance_criteria: for fake audits and logs, the table shows first -> latest for each audit metric and verify counts, failures, median and max within --days, ignoring older runs and unreadable lines
a repo with audits but no runs says 'no verify runs'; no audits at all prints one line saying so
weekly-review.sh output has a '## Target repos' section with the table; its existing test still passes
all 11 harness gates pass, with gate output saved to a file
features.verification: python3 -m pytest tests/test_repo_trend.py -q && bash scripts/tests/test_weekly_review.sh && bash scripts/harness-verify.sh
features.evidence: scripts/repo_trend.py [--days N] renders one markdown table over docs/telemetry/repos/<repo>/*.json and <runtime>/telemetry/<repo>/verify-runs-*.jsonl: audit dates, always-loaded, scoped skill, state-file tokens, drifted hooks and agents with hooks as first -> latest in the window (the latest earlier audit when none falls inside), and verify runs (count, failed, median, max). Unreadable lines and older runs are skipped. weekly-review.sh adds it as '## Target repos'. Tests failed first: tests/test_repo_trend.py (module missing), test_weekly_review.sh (section missing); now 3 and 16 passed. Real run, 7 days: hangar 5403 -> 5438 always-loaded, drifted 2 -> 0, agents claude -> claude,codex,agy, verify 2 runs 1 failed (the fixture bug in feat-082), median 90s; atelier drifted 6 -> 0, agents claude -> all three, verify 1 run 0 failed 10s. mypy and ruff clean; shellcheck findings in weekly-review.sh pre-exist (2 before and after); the test file's new line follows its existing `&& ok || bad` style. harness-verify.sh: all 11 gates passed, output saved to a file. Not done: always-loaded tokens do not include the preflight brief's cost, and state-file tokens are file sizes, not what a session now reads (the brief, measured in feat-081); trace-evaluation.sh was not changed, the weekly review is the cross-repo place.
